deadline.value: Applicants who need a UK visa must apply by 2 August 2027 for a September or October 2027 start. The page gives no earlier funding deadline.
deadline.quote: For research courses that start in September and October 2027, the application deadline for students who require a visa to study in the UK is 2 August 2027.

gre_subject.value: Computer Science has no GRE Subject test, and the course page does not mention one.

supervisor.value: You need an academic supervisor in place before you can be admitted, so you must contact a potential supervisor first.
supervisor.quote: You may not be considered for admission to the MPhil/PhD program in Computer Science without an academic supervisor in place.

entry_route.value: A 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent) is the minimum; an MSc in a related subject is preferred but not required.
entry_route.quote: 2:1 undergraduate degree (or equivalent) and preferably an MSc in a related subject.

notes: The department does not assign supervisors; applicants must find one.
